summary: Crash when changing render distance / java.lang.ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException: Index 28084 out of bounds for length 26136
description: When changing render/view distance via the option menu while standing inside a world, minecraft sometimes crashes with an ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException. This can be best reproduced by spam-clicking the slider in random positions, although for me it crashed after only one click, the first time.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft.
2. Create a new Singleplayer world with default settings.
3. Open the Options menu.
4. Navigate to Video Settings.
5. Change the Render Distance slider to a random position and click it.
6. Wait approximately 1 second.
7. Observe that Minecraft sometimes crashes with an ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException. 
8. Repeat steps 5-7 by spam-clicking the Render Distance slider in random positions.
Observed Behavior: When changing the render distance in Minecraft through the options menu while in a world, the game may experience a crash indicated by the error message java.lang.ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException, specifically stating that Index 28084 is out of bounds for length 26136. This issue arises when the player interacts with the render distance slider, particularly when rapidly clicking it in various positions, which can lead to the game crashing. In some cases, the crash occurs after just one click on the slider. The problem seems to be reproducible under these conditions, and it is critical for developers to investigate the underlying causes related to the array index handling when adjusting render distance settings.
Expected Behavior: When changing the render distance via the options menu while in-game, Minecraft should smoothly adjust the view distance without crashing or throwing any exceptions. Users should be able to click and drag the render distance slider multiple times, and the game should correctly apply the new settings without any performance issues or errors. The game should maintain stability and allow for seamless gameplay regardless of the render distance chosen.
